original_question: Provide examples of real-world systems from areas such as physics, mechanics, biology, or economics that can be modeled as locally conformal symplectic flows or maps.
target_in_paper: The draft most directly targets the unnumbered open problem in Alfonso Sorrentino’s contribution: “Provide examples of real-world systems (from physics, mechanics, biology, economics, etc…) that can be modeled as locally conformal symplectic flows or maps.” ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/html/2602.12896v1))
correct_elements: Your draft is already very close to the paper’s official formulation: it asks for concrete real-world examples, keeps the same application areas named in the paper, and focuses specifically on locally conformal symplectic flows or maps rather than on conformally symplectic systems in general. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/html/2602.12896v1))
missing_details: The formal geometric setting is omitted: the nearby context defines a locally conformal symplectic structure as a triple (M, η, ω), where η is a closed 1-form and ω is a nondegenerate 2-form satisfying d_ηω = 0 for d_η = d - η∧. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/html/2602.12896v1))

If the question is meant for flows, the paper’s dynamical definition should be stated: a vector field X on (M, η, ω) is conformally symplectic if there exists a smooth function a such that L_Xω = aω and L_Xη = da. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/html/2602.12896v1))

The intended motivation is not arbitrary l.c.s. geometry, but the modeling of non-conservative systems with non-uniform or spatially dependent dissipation; that intent is implicit in the draft and should be made explicit in a stand-alone version. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/html/2602.12896v1))

The paper contrasts this problem with the already understood globally conformally symplectic case on a symplectic manifold, where the conformal factor is constant, so the refined question should make clear that genuinely local conformal symplectic behavior is being sought. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/html/2602.12896v1))

Section 2 develops the flow/vector-field formalism, but does not separately formalize l.c.s. maps there; a fully self-contained mathematical version should either focus on flows or explain that a discrete-time map is intended to preserve the l.c.s. structure up to local conformal rescaling. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/html/2602.12896v1))

The nearby discussion also narrows to cotangent-bundle models and asks for physical examples fitting the locally conformal cotangent-bundle equations (12)–(14), so mentioning that preferred mechanical test case keeps the question especially close to the paper’s applied intent. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/html/2602.12896v1))
refined_question: Exhibit a concrete real-world dissipative system—arising naturally in physics, mechanics, biology, economics, or a comparable applied domain—whose evolution is genuinely modeled by a locally conformal symplectic structure rather than merely by the globally conformally symplectic constant-factor case: namely, find a smooth phase space carrying a locally conformal symplectic structure (M, η, ω), with η a closed 1-form and ω a nondegenerate 2-form satisfying d_ηω = 0 for d_η = d - η∧, together with a continuous-time dynamics generated by a vector field X for which there exists a smooth function a such that L_Xω = aω and L_Xη = da (and, if one wishes to work in discrete time, an analogous map preserving the l.c.s. structure up to local conformal rescaling). In particular, identify examples that realize the paper’s intended regime of non-uniform or spatially dependent dissipation and are not just globally conformally symplectic models in disguise. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/html/2602.12896v1))
justification: The draft is aimed at Alfonso Sorrentino’s open problem, not at Conjecture 1 or the periodic-orbit problems elsewhere in the paper, because its wording is already almost verbatim the wording of the unnumbered problem in that section. The surrounding text then supplies exactly the hidden assumptions needed to make the question mathematically stand alone: first the contrast with constant-factor conformally symplectic dynamics on a symplectic manifold, then the l.c.s. differential d_η in Definition 4, the l.c.s. structure in Definition 8, the conformally symplectic vector-field condition in Definition 10, and finally the cotangent-bundle specialization together with the follow-up request for physical examples fitting equations (12)–(14). The refined version therefore adds only paper-local formal context and does not broaden the problem beyond the paper’s actual intent. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/html/2602.12896v1))
